source.entry: 2026-09-18 — acme-portal-sample-015: the environment an evidence bead needs is checked before it is dispatched
source.quote: Before dispatching a bead whose Definition of Done includes live evidence, the orchestrator checks the preconditions and names them in the description: whether the backend needs the VPN up, which port the auth realm whitelists (a dev server on any other port cannot sign in), which seeded account the screen needs, and where the evidence must end up.

input: [repo: acme-portal] Three sample records are available in the development test service, including one with a long label. The backend is reachable without private network access. Repeat the live record-list evidence.

reply.verification: runs verify command `pnpm lint` in the bead's worktree after the worker ends

reply.title: Record list columns at tablet widths
Record row menu at tablet widths

reply.description:
Capture the record page of the batch branch, signed in, at 430px and 1023px wide, on the real dev backend. Change no code and commit nothing.

Report each capture as `Check: <width> - PASS|FAIL - <what it shows>`.
reply.notes:
Verification incomplete: the following Check: lines did not PASS:
> Check: 430px - FAIL - sign-in failed: the identity service redirected to "Invalid parameter: redirect_uri"; the dev server ran on http://localhost:5180 and the service allows only http://localhost:8400 (playwright.config.ts:6-8)
> Check: 1023px - FAIL - signed in as demo-admin@example.test after moving the server to 8400, but the account has no records on dev, so the page shows its empty state

reply.title: Live evidence: record list page at 430px and 1023px

assertions.line: Before the re-dispatch, the run names the preconditions for the worker, in the re-dispatch instructions or in the updated task description: serve the app on port 8400, which the sign-in realm whitelists; sign in as demo-admin@example.test; and put the captures somewhere that survives the worktree (the GitLab project uploads API, or a named path outside the worktree) with the links or path in the final message.
